audit.why: Jayce owns 1-3, 4-5 and 6 are skill windows, Yi takes first item and 2+ items. Full phases[].side and content win[] agree row-for-row and match the packet chart.

Four spikes placed at 3-5, level 6, first item and late; breakdown.spikes correctly identifies Jayce's early Acceleration Gate and Eclipse timings against Yi's level 6 and item spikes. The level 6 spike is right for the right reason — his R is a stance swap available from level 1, not a level 6 power spike — and that is now stated explicitly rather than implied.
audit.corrected: Thundering Blow's 20s cooldown and the R's 6s swap timer added.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two omissions. (a) Thundering Blow is described only as interrupting the Alpha Strike approach; it is a knockback, so it also cancels Meditate outright — and dosFull[1] explicitly tells the player to channel W to heal off his poke without warning that his E ends it. (b) Nothing anywhere mentions that Jayce's stance swap is an auto-attack reset and that his first attack after swapping to cannon shreds armour and magic resist, so the player has no tell for the burst and no reason to understand why resists underperform here.
audit.why: The swap, not a cast animation, is the cue to step back — that is the whole burst tell in this matchup. And Highlander's slow immunity answering his hammer-Q slow was only half-stated ('beats his disengage'), which is worth naming precisely.
audit.corrected: Meditate cancellation written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1], report[5] and spikes[0]; the swap reset and resist shred into report[5]; the slow immunity named against hammer-Q in report[5] and mid.
sources: brief enemyKit E and R text

audit.whatIsWrong: report[14] cites 51.83%; the packet reports 57.44% over 390 games.
audit.why: One number, taken from the packet. The EVEN rating undersells a 57% lane, so the corrected line keeps the rating but names the gap rather than hiding it.

edits.before: Track his E, Thundering Blow — the knockback both interrupts my Alpha Strike approach and sets up his Q3 burst; if he uses it to push or to disengage, that's my window to commit.
edits.after: Track his E, Thundering Blow (20s at rank 1) — the knockback interrupts my approach and cancels Meditate outright; if he spends it to push or disengage, that is my window to commit.

edits.before: Channel W out of his Shock Blast line to heal off his poke so his chip never adds up to a kill or a gankable health bar.
edits.after: Channel W outside Shock Blast range and outside Thundering Blow, which knocks you back and cancels the heal outright.

edits.before: Alpha Strike (Q) goes untargetable through his Shock Blast and over his Acceleration Gate; Wuju Style (E) true damage ignores any armor he buys and shreds his squishy build; Meditate (W) out-sustains his lane poke; Highlander (R) slow-immunity beats his disengage and the kill-reset chains fights. His Thundering Blow (E) knockback is the one thing that interrupts my engage — respect it.
edits.after: Alpha Strike (Q) goes untargetable through his Shock Blast and over his Acceleration Gate; Wuju Style (E) true damage ignores any armour he buys; Meditate (W) out-sustains his poke but Thundering Blow knocks me out of the channel; Highlander (R) slow-immunity beats his hammer-Q slow and the kill-reset chains fights. His stance swap is an auto reset and the first cannon attack shreds my resists — the swap is the tell.

edits.before: EVEN (51.83%) — a punishing early lane against elite melee-poke that I survive into a brutal scaling flip; respect levels 1-5, then take over from first item.
edits.after: EVEN on paper, 57.44% in practice — a punishing early lane against elite melee-poke that I survive into a brutal scaling flip; respect levels 1-5, then take over.

edits.before: Jayce's level-3 poke and knockback still out-trade you.
edits.after: Jayce's level-3 poke and 20s knockback still out-trade you.

edits.before: Jayce pokes you out with ranged Shock Blast + Acceleration Gate and can Thundering Blow melee-knockback if you dash in; his early range is oppressive.
edits.after: Jayce pokes with gate-accelerated Shock Blast, and Thundering Blow (20s) knocks you back out of a dash-in and cancels Meditate mid-channel.

edits.before: Around 6 things flatten out as Jayce lacks an ult spike and your Wuju Style scaling comes online, so the lane sits skill-based while you close distance.
edits.after: Around 6 it flattens: his R is only a 6s stance swap, not a spike, while Wuju Style and Highlander's slow immunity let you close through his hammer-Q.

notes: The packet's suspectNames hit ('Use Alpha Strike' in wants.you[1]) is a false positive — the name is correct, the matcher caught the verb. Real gaps were the Thundering Blow knockback cancelling Meditate (the entry actively recommended channelling into it) and the stance swap being an auto reset whose first cannon attack shreds resists, which is the burst tell the page never gave. Level chart untouched and consistent across both layers.
